purpose: Rank reproducible, truth-free components suggested by GSDC 2023 top solutions without using public/private scores for tuning.

public_private_scores.use: context-only; not used for candidate ranking, parameter choice, or gates

adaptive GNSS measurement weighting was used across environments and phone models
primary_source_evidence.inference_boundary: The abstract does not publish the implementation or parameter values; local implementation feasibility is an inference from the raw fields and existing code.

exact_evidence: Doppler was used for time-synchronized position/velocity prediction
corrected pseudorange DGNSS and TDCP updated position/velocity
Doppler and TDCP validated or excluded invalid measurements
primary_source_evidence.inference_boundary: The abstract does not establish that a Doppler-only postprocess matches the full two-stage estimator; the selected local candidate is deliberately smaller.

reported solution families included FGO, PPK float, and FGO plus TensorFlow

truth_free_doppler_probe.interpretation: finite, physically plausible Doppler velocity is observable from handset fields; this supports a small Doppler position-update candidate but does not establish accuracy

ranked_candidates.component: weighted Doppler receiver-velocity estimate with bounded position prediction/update
ranked_candidates.expected_impact: high relative to WLS-only outlier tails; lower than full FGO/INS
ranked_candidates.data_availability: adequate: pseudorange rate, satellite ECEF position/velocity, WLS position, clock state
ranked_candidates.leakage_risk: low; only truth-free observable fields and declared physical bounds
ranked_candidates.compute_dependency_cost: low/medium; NumPy only, no proprietary assets
ranked_candidates.known_risk: Doppler prediction can drift or amplify a handset timing bias; fail closed to WLS on invalid geometry, clock transition, long gap, or large innovation

ranked_candidates.component: estimate GNSS/IMU timing offset and feed adaptive covariance to a tightly coupled filter
ranked_candidates.expected_impact: very high if full coupled model is available
ranked_candidates.data_availability: partial: IMU and GNSS are present, but orientation/lever-arm and a validated coupled handset solver are not
ranked_candidates.leakage_risk: medium unless offset is estimated only from independent observable signals
ranked_candidates.compute_dependency_cost: high; would require new deterministic coupled filter and calibration contract
ranked_candidates.known_risk: existing motion-adaptive process-noise lane does not estimate offset and is development-only
ranked_candidates.implementation_status: deferred until candidate 1 is either promoted or rejected

ranked_candidates.component: stricter ADR/timing/uncertainty and per-satellite robust measurement selection
ranked_candidates.data_availability: adequate fields; integrating a new raw solver is substantial
ranked_candidates.leakage_risk: low if all thresholds are predeclared
ranked_candidates.known_risk: existing adapter already enforces many validity contracts; duplicate filtering may remove useful observations
ranked_candidates.implementation_status: fallback candidate if rank 1 is blocked

ranked_candidates.known_risk: fixed train leave-one-route-out gate already failed materially

ranked_candidates.data_availability: blocked: no local map/route asset and fetched OSM would compromise sealed reproducibility
ranked_candidates.leakage_risk: medium/high due map freshness and route-specific geometry
ranked_candidates.known_risk: cannot be evaluated under the current offline artifact contract
ranked_candidates.implementation_status: No-Go until an approved versioned map asset exists

frozen_split.selection_basis: central-directory metadata only; route-disjoint roles; fresh validation and future holdout had no materialized payload or truth read at freeze

frozen_candidate.algorithm: weighted least-squares receiver velocity from pseudorange rate after subtracting line-of-sight satellite velocity; one-step ECEF prediction from prior selected position; position update by covariance-derived gain
frozen_candidate.observation_equation: PseudorangeRate = LOS dot (satellite_velocity - receiver_velocity) + receiver_clock_range_rate; solve with A=[-LOS,1] and b=PseudorangeRate-LOS dot satellite_velocity
frozen_candidate.measurement_weight: inverse square of finite PseudorangeRateUncertaintyMetersPerSecond, floored at 0.10 m/s
frozen_candidate.position_update: prediction + gain*(WLS-prediction); gain uses finite WLS quality proxy and Doppler residual covariance; if the innovation exceeds the fixed gate, publish WLS and reset the prediction chain
frozen_candidate.first_epoch: publish exact WLS position and initialize chain
frozen_candidate.invalid_policy: finite WLS is always preferred; invalid Doppler, clock transition, timestamp gap, rank deficiency, nonfinite covariance, or out-of-range speed falls back to WLS and resets

frozen_gates.train: all three route-level H P50/P95, V P95, availability, truth coverage, and four diagnostics non-regressed versus exact WLS; require strict aggregate H P95 and diagnostic-mean improvement
frozen_gates.fresh_validation: open only after train artifact hashes are sealed; require per-route and aggregate non-regression on all metrics and strict aggregate H P95 improvement
frozen_gates.future_holdout: remain unopened unless fresh validation passes; one truth read only after truth-free artifacts are sealed; no post-holdout tuning or rerun
frozen_gates.promotion: development-only recommended lane; production RTK/SPP defaults unchanged
